title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 0.00 (quiet) at 06 UTC on 6 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 6 日 06 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 0.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 0.00 (0Z) at 06 UTC on 6 October 2026. The 06 hour is complete (60 samples through 06:59; hour-start 0.00/0Z, hour-end 1.67/2M). Last-180 maximum is 3.33 (first at 2026-10-06T05:14:00Z; label 3P). Published-window maximum is 3.33 (first at 2026-10-06T02:14:00Z; label 3P). Window starts 2026-10-06T02:00:00Z (358 samples). Window estimated_kp reached 3.33. The 07 UTC hour is incomplete (58 samples through 07:57).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
